description: This Java source file defines the class `Table1D`, a subclass of `TableWithData`. It manages a one-dimensional table structure for a UI component, including table population, navigation, highlighting, and data management functionalities, within the context of a larger software project related to tuning and logging of automotive parameters.

classes.name: Table1D
classes.description: Represents a one-dimensional table component in a UI, managing data cells, navigation, and highlighting, extending `TableWithData`.

methods.name: setAxisParent
methods.description: Sets the parent axis table for this 1D table.

methods.name: getAxisParent
methods.description: Returns the parent axis table associated with this table.

methods.name: addStaticDataCell
methods.description: Adds a static data cell to the table's data array.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table with byte array input data, setting up UI layout and labels.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Table1D, indicating its type.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Handles cursor movement upwards within the table, considering parent axis type.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Handles cursor movement downwards, interacting with parent axis and other table types.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Moves the cursor left within the table.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Moves the cursor right within the table.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the current cell selection, delegating to the parent axis.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a cell at given coordinates, clearing previous selections.

methods.name: getCellAsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a cell at a specific index.

methods.name: highlightLiveData
methods.description: Highlights the cell corresponding to a live data value, updating trace visuals.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether live data highlighting is supported (returns false).

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether the table button is selected (always true).

methods.name: isAxis
methods.description: Returns whether this table functions as an axis.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Table1D object, including data content and axis type.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears live data trace visuals, including invoking parent clear.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the table label display.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns the table's data as a tab-separated string, formatted for static or dynamic data.
